subject: On‑prem package options: starter amortization, operator licenses, and pilot credit
messages:
From: Samantha Cross <samantha.cross@heliomed.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Jordan Park <jordan.park@heliomed.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: On‑prem packaging — ask re: amortization and operator SKUs

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the KV caching behavior. We are trying to map the private deployment commercials to our procurement cycles and have two specific asks before we take this to finance: 

1) Starter amortization: can you outline a way we can amortize the initial platform/one‑time fee over the first 12 months on the invoice so it doesn’t hit Q3 CapEx in full?

2) Operator vs. seat licenses: we have a small on‑site ops team (~5 operators) and a larger group of app owners who will call the API. Is there a compact SKU we can buy for operator access (flat) and then metered token / node licensing for the rest?

Also — would Redwood consider a limited pilot credit (one month of burst capacity) if we commit to a 12‑month starter onprem engagement? If so, what are the conditions?

Appreciate a short bullet reply we can forward to procurement.

Best,
Samantha Cross
Head of Platform Engineering
HelioMed

---
Attachment: HelioPilot_SOW_draft.pdf (pdf, 72KB)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Cross <samantha.cross@heliomed.com>, Jordan Park <jordan.park@heliomed.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On‑prem packaging — ask re: amortization and operator SKUs

Samantha — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers first, then a proposed commercial approach: 

- Starter amortization: yes. We can invoice the one‑time platform activation as a separately‑line item and amortize it over 12 months on the invoice schedule for accounting. For contract language we typically add a schedule showing the amortized monthly charge; we can produce a sample invoice.

- Operator vs seat: we offer an "Operator License" SKU (flat annual fee per named operator) plus a separate consumption SKU for inference tokens or node‑hours. Typical structure for customers like you: 5 operator licenses + metered consumption for app owners. Operator licenses include admin UI access, support escalation lanes, and one seat for local SRE tooling.

- Pilot credit: we can offer a one‑month burst credit equal to 10% of forecasted monthly consumption for the pilot, conditioned on: (a) a 12‑month minimum term on the private deployment contract; (b) acceptance of our standard SOW and oncall retainer; (c) Redwood retains rights to audit consumption during the pilot.

Proposed next steps (bullets you can forward):
- Redwood will deliver: sample amortized invoice + contract schedule (2 business days)
- HelioMed confirms operator count and a pilot consumption forecast (tokens/node‑hours)
- We exchange an SOW and pilot milestone plan; Redwood provides the pilot credit within the first invoice after pilot activation

I’ve attached a draft SKU grid to show how Operator vs consumption SKUs map (see privdeploy-sku-grid.xlsx). Laura — can you confirm the SRE oncall retainer bands for HelioMed scale? Ben — happy to loop legal on contract schedule language.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: privdeploy-sku-grid.xlsx (xlsx, 18KB)

From: Samantha Cross <samantha.cross@heliomed.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Jordan Park <jordan.park@heliomed.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On‑prem packaging — ask re: amortization and operator SKUs

Thanks Karthik — helpful. A couple follow ups from procurement and finance: 

- Procurement wants the amortized schedule spelled out in the MSA as "Activation fee: $120,000 amortized monthly over 12 months = $10,000/mo" rather than a separate one‑time invoice followed by credits. Is that something Redwood will accept?

- Finance wants clarity on whether operator licenses can be time‑bound (e.g., monthly) or must be annual. They prefer monthly so they can scale down after pilot.

Also, one constraint: we cannot accept an audit clause that allows Redwood continuous monitoring of production traffic. We’re fine with a usage attestation plus redacted logs for verification.

Jordan and I are available for a quick 30‑minute call today at 2pm PT if that helps resolve.

Thanks,
Samantha

Subject: Re: On‑prem packaging — ask re: amortization and operator SKUs

Samantha / Jordan — quick update after syncing with finance and legal: 

- Activation fee language: we can accept the MSA schedule line you suggested. We will include an explicit amortization table in Exhibit B: "Activation fee: $120,000 amortized over 12 months = $10,000/mo" and mark the activation fee as non‑refundable per standard. That should satisfy procurement booking.

- Operator license cadence: we can support monthly operator licenses for the pilot period (first 90 days) with a three‑month minimum. After the pilot we’ll convert to annual renewals unless HelioMed elects to keep month‑to‑month at a +15% premium on the per‑operator price. This gives you flexibility while protecting Redwood from churn.

- Audit / usage verification: we cannot accept continuous monitoring of production traffic. We can accept (1) self‑attestation of monthly usage, (2) redacted KPM exports shared quarterly, and (3) a one‑time third‑party verification within the pilot window if required.

I attached a redline sample of Exhibit B and the proposed SOW milestone table. If that aligns, we can run legal review and prepare a DocuSign package.

Next: confirm operator count and whether HelioMed wants the 10% pilot credit applied as a credit against the month 2 invoice or as a prepaid burst token bucket.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
